text:
# Close wrap, Wed 2026-11-11

**Indexes:** S&P 500 +1.3% to 7,619.38, Nasdaq +1.6% to 25,466.19, Dow +0.5% to 52,486.49. The AI rebound left the S&P 2.6% below its October record. Bond market closed for Veterans Day ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/wall-street-stocks-dow-nasdaq-027cd5f4583d1a11c1795150bf065afb); [AP](https://apnews.com/article/stock-markets-ai-earnings-oil-297d040c83844a9563327340b370c24e)).

**Why:** CRWV +24.7% (best day since 6/2025) after its Q3 beat and a pledge not to tap unsecured debt markets ([Kiplinger](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/stocks/nasdaq-adds-400-points-after-coreweave-earnings-stock-market-today)). MU +11.9%, AVGO +4% (AP). NVDA +2.9% despite Baird's downgrade to Neutral (CEO-tenure question), and Morgan Stanley dropped it from its Top Pick list (Kiplinger).

**Covered:** COST +2.0% after a $30 special dividend (record date 11/24, paid 12/4) and a $4B buyback (Kiplinger; [Costco IR](https://investor.costco.com/news/news-details/2026/Costco-Wholesale-Corporation-Declares-30-Special-Cash-Dividend-and-Reauthorizes-Stock-Repurchase-Program/default.aspx)). Past specials averaged +1.5% from announcement to record date ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/investingclub/2026/11/11/costco-is-giving-shareholders-a-big-early-holiday-gift-how-to-make-sure-you-get-it.html)).

**After hours:** CTVA reports (first report as a pure crop-protection company; consensus EPS ~$0.10, revenue $1.77B), call Thursday at 9 AM ([Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/analyst-stock-ratings/price-target/26/11/63133599/corteva-earnings-are-imminent-these-most-accurate-analysts-revise-forecasts-ahead-of-earnings-call)). Results weren't out at writing time.

**Tomorrow:** NBIS reports before the open; AMAT and CSCO after the close; jobless claims at 8:30. PPI Friday. AI-hardware group avoid stays through 11/13 (sector-shock bounce lesson).

**Ideas (swing, long-only):**
- COST: special dividend + buyback, staples rotation, non-tech capital-return catalyst. Confidence low. Risks: 46x forward P/E, and the stock drops ~$30 on the 11/24 ex-date. **Exit by the 11/23 close.**
- HUM: carried hold, med. Not re-logged.
